notes.title: Fawn Route Voice Acting - OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's finally the time everyone's been waiting for - the Fawn VA patch is now live on Steam!

Here's a quick list of changes:

[list]
[*] Fawn route audio implemented
[*] Audio adjusted in all other parts of the game
[*] Some CGs adjusted
[*] Settings adjusted
[*] Minor text inconsistencies adjusted
[/list]

We're finally at the point where the game is fully voiced! It's taken a long time, and along the way we've had many, MANY people assisting us with getting the voice acting complete.

This wouldn't have been doable without the help of our audio editor, Cats on a Lilypad Studios. Check them out on [url=https://twitter.com/CatsLilypad]Twitter[/url] if you've enjoyed The Divine Speaker - I think their games will be right up your alley.

A quick note: You may experience issues with your save files if they are within Fawn's route. We've made major changes to the line identifiers that make our voice acting work, so old saves can be unstable. If you have any problems with your saves, start a new game and skip through to where you were up to.

There we have it! As a final little plug, our new game Dreambound (BL mystery visual novel) has 12 hours left [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gabmag/dreambound?ref=2u5kjl]on Kickstarter[/url]! If you like BL, pretty art and a (hopefully!!!) interesting story, then check it out here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316591/affe12845bf5b8e7d9c99445f3d45c6ff1fc3153.png[/img]

We also have one opportunity left to create a character that will be in our next The Divine Speaker game (a sequel that follows Nox and Soren!).

That's all for now! 
I really hope you enjoy The Divine Speaker!

Gabby, Lead Developer
Two and a Half Studios

notes.title: Fawn Voice Acting Route & Bug Fixes & Fundraising Campaign
notes.content:
Hello gamers!

Gabby here with a quick update on the Fawn route voice acting patch!

First of all, I hope you've all been enjoying the Leos route. Did you know that the game has over 15,000 voice files? Our poor audio editor can probably recite them all by heart...

Anywho, onto the update!


[h2]Fawn Route VA[/h2]

All voice lines for Fawn's route have been cut, edited, and inserted into the game. We're awaiting three actors sending in a few lines that needed either redoing or were missed in the initial recordings. We're hoping this won't take too long to receive.

Our audio editor is handling communication with the actors, editing and insertion of these extra lines, so at the moment we're hands off of The Divine Speaker while these last few audio related tasks are completed. 


[h2]Bug Fixes & Other Updates[/h2]
The latest build of The Divine Speaker includes a few bug fixes - mainly audio related, as well as a few extra CGs. We're planning to add one final one to the final release as a thank you for your patience.

[h2]Fundraising Campaign[/h2]

[previewyoutube=E_lrj_RREGY;full][/previewyoutube]

We're currently running a Kickstarter for our next BL project, Dreambound!

Dreambound is the story of a reclusive painter named Noah with the ability to enter dreams, and a series of murders (of people he used to know). It's a gorgeous, moody BL game that fans of TDS are sure to enjoy.

We have 13 days left on the campaign and we're currently 94% funded. We're so close! If it's within your means, even $5 goes a long way into continuing our game development journey.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gabmag/dreambound?ref=c01if6]Click here to check it out![/url]
